info.title: RocketMQ Rust AI SRE API
info.description: Canonical checked-in Phase 02 Control Plane and UI contract. Phase 02 adds typed alert, topology, forecast, simulation, readiness, notification and postmortem schemas while preserving the read-only RocketMQ boundary.

200.description: SSE stream containing WorkflowStreamEvent data frames
Bounded topology projection for correlated resources
Explainable multi-window SLO and eight-dimension cluster score
Deterministic cluster health including SLO, evidence, changes and incidents
Tenant and optional region health aggregated by worst cluster without averaging
Explainable 7d/30d capacity, backlog ETA, seasonal anomaly, change-point and accuracy report
Deterministic advisory-only what-if result with no execution eligibility
Postmortem head, immutable revisions and follow-up metadata
Updated SRE metadata with immutable lifecycle event
Read-only cluster boundary and mutable SRE incident metadata state
Audited incident metadata operation; terminal reopen creates a linked incident
Bounded shift handoff across incidents, changes, expiry, capacity, action items and source gaps
Daily or weekly operations report as JSON or a downloadable Markdown/HTML artifact

Bounded operator action applied to incident metadata.

These actions never call RocketMQ mutation APIs. Reopening or splitting
creates a linked incident instead of mutating a terminal incident.
